text:
Stop calling it unwinding. You are hiding.

Your brain knows something is wrong. The drink tells it to shut up. The weed does the same.

So the problem stays. And it gets bigger.

Alcohol and weed kill brain cells. Wreck your organs. And they make the damage invisible so you keep going back.

You are not relaxing. You are running from yourself.

Tonight, when the craving hits, sit with it for 10 minutes. No drink. No smoke.

Discomfort is the cost of becoming someone worth being.
caption:
Most men mistake running from discomfort for self improvement. The men with real discipline sit in the silence.
Send this to a man who needs it today.
